title: Cosmic Skull Paint Explosion
description: A large split-composition artwork featuring a black and white line-drawn skull divided between a white swirling cosmic background on the left and a black starry space scene on the right. Vibrant paint splatters in magenta, cyan, yellow, and purple burst from the skull's mouth and eyes, flowing over a detailed throne with a skeletal king figure seated upon it. A hooded robed figure stands on the right holding a paintbrush.
prompt: Surreal split composition artwork with a large black and white skull at center, left side showing swirling galaxy patterns and black holes on white background, right side depicting deep space with colorful galaxies and stars on black. Vibrant magenta, cyan, yellow, and purple paint explosively splattering from the skull's mouth and eye sockets, dripping over an ornate throne with a skeletal king seated on it. A hooded figure in patterned robes stands on the right holding a paintbrush, white line art style mixed with colorful paint drips.
